name: Rizwan Virk
abstract_title: NPC Mode: Consciousness, Materialism, Determinism and the Simulation Hypothesis
abstract: Recently a technoscientific narrative has arisen which parallels and updateds many metaphysical ideas of consciousness, religion, and reality: the simulation hypothesis, which is the idea that we are all in a compute simulation. This paper explores the NPC vs. RPG flavors of simulation theory, and shows how they parallel legacy discussions of materialism vs. spiritualism, consciousness being primary vs. secondary, and free will vs. determinism.
